description: Upload a finished gif/mp4/webp to the share server (gifgif.dev unless configured otherwise) and get a direct URL, a share page, and ready-to-paste markdown and HTML. A link is handed out only once the file exists.

expires.description: How long the link lives: 1d, 7d, 30d, 90d, or never (free links last at most 90 days). Use a short one for recordings that show private things.

name: gif_share
